source_locator.review_scope: complete rendered article; statements anchored to article sections rather than timestamps

environment.context: studio production and club live sets

goal: Produce vocal-led house tracks and perform live club sets from a pre-optimized template.
starting_state: Self-reported general practice rather than a single observed session.

ordered_action_sequence.action: Keep a clip-based Session workflow and listen to projects on loop all day while iterating.
Play parts live by hand using any synth or sampler with amplitude and filter envelopes; avoid chord generators and fixed key signatures.

Build the instrumental first; record a take or two of vocals; trash most of a verse and loop a portion, or bounce the track to a new instrumental; sometimes re-record older lyrics onto a newer beat; never punch in.
Control Live through an Elgato Stream Deck XL sending MIDI commands and use Mackie automation for channel levels, performing without looking at the laptop screen.

Keep monitoring latency at zero for vocals, set the sound-card buffer as low as tolerable, hover over added plugins to check reported latency, and rebuild/remap/reroute the set in minutes when needed.

repeated_inner_loop.observed: Loop-listen to the project, adjust, and continue; for vocals: record few takes, discard most, loop the strongest fragment.
